answer: Rate-limit identities through a single inlet: every new account must pass one shared admission queue that admits a fixed number of newcomers per epoch, each needing a graded passing answer before it can vote or earn. A farm can't spawn a thousand seats at once; each clone waits its turn and must keep passing. Standing then grows like a vine on a trellis, one graded epoch at a time, so building a sybil army is a long, costly voyage instead of a single burst.
